rationale: Raw-count columns (block 'raw counts', columns 4-9) are named WT_T0, KO_T0, WT_T7_R1/R2, KO_T7_R1/R2, matching the GSM titles; prepare.R extracts them. The paper ranks genes by the difference between NF2-KO and NF2-WT in log2(passage 7 / passage 0) (Fig. 1F-G), i.e. the genotype x time interaction: 6 libraries, 4 coefficients, 2 residual df. Replicates R1/R2 are not stated to be paired across genotypes, so no replicate term. The direct KO vs WT comparison at passage 7 (2 vs 2) is a sensitivity analysis that does not correct for the passage-0 representation. Controls are the 142 non-cutting EGFP/LacZ/luciferase guides of TKOv3.
